title: ACSN Retaliation Violence Forces Troop Deployment to Santa Marta
detail: Armed men loyal to the ACSN set fire to at least three vehicles — including a taxi and a public bus — and threatened merchants across Santa Marta on September 22, 2026, in retaliation for the killing of alias 'Cholo' the day before. President Abelardo de la Espriella toured the city in an armored vehicle wearing a bulletproof vest and vowed, 'I swear by Colombia and by my life that I will finish them off ... I will send them to hell in a body bag,' before ordering troops into the city. Security forces made five arrests — three in Santa Marta, two in Riohacha — as the president said, 'We're going after the rest.' It was the first troop-deployment operation of de la Espriella's presidency.

media.caption: Police escort alleged ACSN paramilitary members in Santa Marta, September 23, 2026

title: Trump Rallies 'Shield of the Americas' Coalition Against FARC Dissidents, ELN, Clan del Golfo
detail: On the sidelines of the 81st UN General Assembly in New York on September 22, 2026, US President Donald Trump convened leaders and foreign ministers of the 'Shield of the Americas' anti-cartel coalition and urged member states to formally designate 24 criminal and armed organizations as common threats to regional stability and apply sanctions against them. The list includes Colombia's FARC dissident factions (the Estado Mayor Central, Segunda Marquetalia and their affiliates), the ELN, and the Clan del Golfo, alongside Mexico's MS-13 and Tren de Aragua at the top. Colombian officials confirmed Colombian forces — not US troops — would lead any resulting operations against these groups on Colombian soil, aligning the initiative with President de la Espriella's own hardline offensive launched weeks earlier.
